subject.name: MF 10mm F8 I APS-C Fisheye Lens

unresolved: The current product title emphasizes Fuji X, but Nikon Z remains an explicit sold-out mount option and is included in the official specification graphic. Sold-out status does not by itself establish discontinuation.

Five gallery images and four description graphics were inspected, with the lower specification table enlarged. Front/side/capped views and Sony/Fuji mounted views are available; Nikon Z four-side and exposed-rear coverage remains unconfirmed.

The shared diagram gives approximately 58 mm diameter, 11 mm height and 80 g across numerous mounts without identifying the measurement configuration or Z-specific applicability. These values are not added to the currently unknown Nikon Z dimensions or weight.
Visible 0.3 and infinity labels indicate focusing direction and endpoints, but a calibrated distance scale is not established. Caps are pictured, but supplied status is not explicit.
